phases.name: Concept
phases.purpose: Understand the idea, fix the creative identity and establish what is and is not being made.
exitCriteria: Concept brief approved by the Studio Director
Technology radar and asset plan exist
Scope and out-of-scope list agreed

phases.name: Design
phases.purpose: Turn the concept into implementable systems, world, story, UX and production plan.
exitCriteria: Game design document approved with numbers
World bible, UX flows and specialist system designs approved
Production plan with milestones approved

phases.name: Technical Planning
phases.purpose: Choose the engine and architecture, set budgets, and define the data and platform contracts.
exitCriteria: Engine decision recorded as an ADR
Runtime architecture and platform matrix approved
Performance budget, data model and pipeline conventions approved

phases.name: Art Direction
phases.purpose: Fix the visual and audio language and the asset requirements that follow from it.
exitCriteria: Art direction bible approved
World layout, lighting, UI and animation plans approved
Asset, model and effect lists exist with budgets

phases.name: Prototype
phases.purpose: Prove the core loop is playable and fun in a real build before mass production.
exitCriteria: Playable prototype build exists and is reachable
Core loop demonstrated end to end
Go or no-go decision recorded

phases.name: Production
phases.purpose: Every department produces and integrates its systems, assets and content.
exitCriteria: Every active department's production deliverables approved
All content integrated into one build
Milestone report shows no unowned blocker

phases.name: Testing
phases.purpose: Find out what is actually broken across gameplay, interface, compatibility, saves and performance.
exitCriteria: Test report approved with no unlinked failures
Compatibility and input parity verified
No open blocker bug

phases.name: Optimisation
phases.purpose: Hit the frame and memory budgets on the weakest declared hardware, measured rather than claimed.
exitCriteria: Performance gate passes on every declared platform profile
Lighting, VFX, environment and pipeline budgets met
Lowest quality tier verified playable on the weakest device

phases.name: Polish
phases.purpose: Refine feel, clarity and presentation against the creative pillars without adding scope.
exitCriteria: Creative sign-off against every pillar
Tuning, mix and cinematic reviews approved
No polish task changes agreed scope

phases.name: Release
phases.purpose: Verify the release candidate against every gate and hand over a build plus its known issues.
exitCriteria: Release checklist signed with evidence links
QA regression green, licence audit clean, integrity audit clean
Built artefact identified by version, commit and build command
